role: District Representative · Eastern Samar, Lone District
summary: Eastern Samar representative with 60 principal-authored bills. Authored travel-tax abolition and a bill fixing barangay and SK terms. Co-authored the national minimum wage, a staggered 200-peso daily wage increase and stronger occupational safety standards.
caveat: Labor evidence is co-authored only; barangay-term bill is a single issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored national minimum wage, a staggered 200-peso wage hike and occupational safety standards (-2 to -3, labor), offset by authored travel tax abolition (+1). Two issues.
